facts.P1_fx_receipts: Yes; individuals can keep export earnings in dollars at a local bank since April 2026.
facts.P2_fcy_account: Yes: USD accounts at local banks, with no bank fees on incoming transfers.
facts.P3_local_gateways: Mercado Pago payment links work with a free account, no website needed.
facts.L1_registration: Register with ARCA for a CUIT and join the Monotributo.
facts.L2_tax_id: CUIT, from ARCA, using fiscal key level 3 and your DNI.
facts.L3_income_tax_foreign: Monotributo replaces income tax and IVA with one monthly fee by category.
facts.L4_vat_gst: 21% IVA; exports are zero-rated; Monotributo already includes IVA.
facts.L5_data_protection: Ley 25.326: register customer databases online with the AAIP.
facts.L6_consumer_ecommerce: Buyers can cancel within 10 days; your site needs a "repentance button".
facts.L7_incentives: Monotributo's single monthly payment, and dollars kept in your own local account.

watch_out.text: To avoid forced conversion, earnings must land in your own local dollar account.
Monotributo categories are updated twice a year; check yours each time.
Websites must show a cancel ("repentance") button without forcing a login.
